streams.infrared.reason: On the ZBook x2 G4 the V4L2 node named "HP IR Camera" offers YUYV 340x340 at 30 fps only. 30 captured frames alternate lit (mean 72-94, max 255) and dark (mean about 5): the IR emitter pulses on its own every other frame, without any extension-unit control set (unit 4 {1229a78c-47b4-4094-b0ce-db07386fb938}, 2 controls, left untouched).
